nodes.text: HMPV virus in India--Two infants in Bengaluru, a three-month-old girl and an eight-month-old boy, have been diagnosed with Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV), marking India's first reported cases. The girl recovered from bronchopneumonia, while the boy remains under medical care.
